name: career-studio
description: Evidence-backed career proof, applications, interviews and outreach with nine complete first-party workflows and optional installed-provider depth.

interface.shortDescription: Build truthful career proof and finish applications
interface.longDescription: Build evidence-backed resumes, cover letters, portfolios, application answers, interview practice and authorized submission records with clear receipt states. Full first-party methods and templates are included. Optional complete AIHumanizer, CoverLetterWriter and UIUXDesigner depth methods come from separately installed official plugins. Job Application Compass and the Career Atlas are optional operator-owned runtimes, not bundled services.
defaultPrompt: Tailor my resume and cover letter to this role using verified evidence.
Build a visual portfolio case from these real artifacts.
Finish this authorized application and verify the employer receipt.
